items.markdown:
Forehead wrinkles are primarily caused by **repetitive facial expressions** (dynamic lines) and the **natural loss of collagen, elastin, and hydration** with age or sun damage (static lines).[[1]](https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/10984-wrinkles)[[2]](https://cosmeticdermatologyjax.com/botox-vs-microneedling-best-options-for-forehead-wrinkles/)[[3]](https://www.goldenstatedermatology.com/blog/say-goodbye-to-forehead-wrinkles-and-hello-to-smoothed-lines/)

### Types of Forehead Wrinkles

- **Dynamic lines:** Horizontal creases or vertical "11" lines that appear only when you raise your eyebrows, squint, or frown.[[1]](https://cosmeticdermatologyjax.com/botox-vs-microneedling-best-options-for-forehead-wrinkles/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/RintFcD554M)
- **Static creases:** Permanent lines that remain visible even when your face is completely relaxed.[[1]](https://cosmeticdermatologyjax.com/botox-vs-microneedling-best-options-for-forehead-wrinkles/)


---

### How to Treat Forehead Wrinkles

#### 1. In-Office & Medical Treatments

- **Neuromodulators (Botox, Dysport, Xeomin):** Temporarily relax the underlying frontalis muscle to smooth dynamic expression lines.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12737568/)[[2]](https://cosmeticdermatologyjax.com/botox-vs-microneedling-best-options-for-forehead-wrinkles/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e7p8bssaF6c&t=54)
- **Dermal Fillers (Juvederm, Restylane):** Hyaluronic acid-based gels injected directly into deep static creases to restore volume and plumpness.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e7p8bssaF6c&t=54)
- **Skin Resurfacing (Lasers, Microneedling, Chemical Peels):** Remove damaged outer layers and trigger new collagen and elastin production.[[1]](https://www.dermsurgery.org/blog/reduce-forehead-wrinkles/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e7p8bssaF6c&t=54)
- **Surgical Options (Brow Lift):** Physical tissue repositioning for heavy brows or significant skin laxity.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e7p8bssaF6c&t=54)

#### 2. Over-the-Counter Skincare & Topical Ingredients

- **Retinoids (Retinol, Retinal, Prescription Tretinoin):** Accelerate cell turnover and stimulate collagen.[[1]](https://forefrontdermatology.com/how-to-get-rid-of-forehead-wrinkles/)[[2]](https://www.isdin.com/us/blog/skincare/how-to-get-rid-of-forehead-wrinkles/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/RintFcD554M)
- **Peptides (Matrixyl, Argireline):** Amino acids that support firmness and relax mild expression lines.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/RintFcD554M)[[2]](https://forefrontdermatology.com/how-to-get-rid-of-forehead-wrinkles/)
- **Hyaluronic Acid & Vitamin C:** Attract moisture to plump superficial fine lines while neutralizing environmental free radicals.[[1]](https://www.isdin.com/us/blog/skincare/how-to-get-rid-of-forehead-wrinkles/)[[2]](https://forefrontdermatology.com/how-to-get-rid-of-forehead-wrinkles/)
- **Non-Invasive Patches (e.g., Frownies):** Paper-based patches worn overnight to mechanically restrict muscle movement and temporarily flatten lines.[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/Frownies-Forehead-Between-Eyes-Patches/dp/B00027DMSI)

#### 3. Daily Prevention

- **Broad-Spectrum Sunscreen (SPF 30 or higher):** Prevents UV-induced collagen breakdown (photoaging).
- **Hydration & Lifestyle:** Drinking adequate water, managing stress, avoiding smoking, and sleeping on your back minimize premature creasing.[[1]](https://www.currentbody.us/blogs/editorial/forehead-wrinkles)[[2]](https://www.isdin.com/us/blog/skincare/how-to-get-rid-of-forehead-wrinkles/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/RintFcD554M)
